physical.title: box
physical.summary:
Slip catalogue:
Small box of hard dark wood, in the shape of a water-bottle, with a flat bottom. To aid in the perforation a circular hole has been made in the bottom and refilled by a disc of wood. Ornamented on side by a broad vertical band of zig-zag on one side and half a similar band on the other. Split at the neck which is surrounded by a thin string to which is attached a string of light blue, pink and red beads.  Lime-box, for lime to be chewed with tobacco.

cultural.vision_reason: The image shows a black earthenware smoking-pipe bowl with faceted lozenge and herringbone incised decoration attached to a bamboo stem, a household/utensil object type plausible for a Malawi-region people such as the Lomwe; no evidence contradicts the attribution.

physical.title: smoking-pipe
physical.summary:
Slip catalogue:
Pipe with straight thin bamboo stem and bowl of black earthenware. The bowl is slightly bell-shaped and rises at right angles from its neck or socket which also expands towards the stem and is of circular section. The bowl is faceted all round by very deep incision so that it appears to have three bands of deeply cut lozenge design. Below the bowl are transverse bands of incised lines enclosing three bands of shallow incised herringbone pattern. Beneath the neck or socket is a perforated projection through which passes a string attaching bowl to stem.

physical.title: smoking-pipe
physical.summary:
Slip catalogue:

The rims of the bowls are flat and projecting and their side edges are ornamented with incised lines. Bowl perforated at butt to receive a string which connects it with the handle.

physical.title: smoking-pipe
physical.summary:
Slip catalogue:
Pipe with thin bamboo stem and heavy bowl of black earthenware. The bowl is slightly bell-shaped and rises at right angles from the neck or socket which is long and thick. It is ornamented by transverse lines of deeply incised lozenge-pattern below the rim, and again after an interval the part where it joins the socket is ornamented by bands of shallow incised conventional design. The neck or socket has on its lower side five raised and rounded ridges (transverse), all of which are perforated to receive a cord, and is ornamented throughout its length by bands of long incised conventional pattern (zig-zag, cross) both longitudinal and transverse. There is a cord round the centre of the stem.
